notes: GUtils::ConvertAngle3DToGame(float r): __ftol(r x 325.94931) & 0x7FF. __ftol 0x7A1400 takes its SSE2 branch (cvttsd2si) or its x87 one (fistp qword, the low 32 bits) by HasSSE2 [0xE83A20], set by the machine baseline (LH3DP3::CheckCPU): they differ when r x 325.9 is out of the int32 range. openblack: gutils::ConvertAngle3DToGame (src/ECS/GUtilsAngle.h), FtoL = the SSE2 branch.
